title: Plakar Home Assistant Importer Connector Config

token.description: Long-lived access token of an administrator, read from PLAKAR_HOMEASSISTANT_TOKEN when omitted

agent.description: Backup agent to use, the local one (backup.local or hassio.local) when omitted

backup.description: Import this existing backup instead of making a new one

name.description: Name of the backup made on the instance, 'plakar <timestamp>' when omitted

password.description: Encrypt the backup on the instance with this password, and decrypt protected backups with it

addons.description: Include every add-on, supervised installs only

folders.description: Comma-separated shared folders to include, supervised installs only

delete.description: Remove the backup from the instance once it has been imported
